review.summary: The chunk meets phase-29 acceptance requirements. Provenance, complete delta classification, unchanged SDK bytes, and recorded checks are supported by inspected evidence. The earlier chunk-declaration bypass is fixed. One minor bookkeeping issue remains; no blocker or high finding. Complete-phase review is still required.

findings.description: Accepting a chunk does not update latest_review. The current accepted chunk names attempt 3 in accepted_review but still names rejected attempt 2 in latest_review. An in-memory reproduction confirmed this persists on subsequent acceptance. The acceptance gate remains effective, but the progress record is misleading.
findings.required_fix: Set latest_review for both accepted and rejected chunk outcomes, and extend the rejection-then-acceptance regression to verify both review pointers.
